title: finereli/whatsapp-mcp
body:
A read-only MCP server that lets your AI agent search and read your own WhatsApp messages. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.

README 節錄：# whatsapp-mcp Let your AI agent read your WhatsApp messages. This is a small server that runs in your own Cloudflare account. You link your phone to it once, the way you'd link WhatsApp Web, and from then on any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, anything that speaks MCP) can search and read your chats. It can read and search your messages, and remember names you give it for phone numbers. It can't send anything. Ask your agent things like: - "What did Dana say about the flights?" - "Find every message where someone mentioned the lease, across all my chats." - "Summarize what I missed in the family group this week." ## How it works Your phone stays the source of truth. The server is a linked device that your agent talks to. It doesn't stay connected to WhatsApp. When your agent asks for something, and once a day, it connects, collects whatever WhatsApp queued for it since last time, writes that to its own database, and hangs up. Your phone keeps working normally and keeps getting notifications. Your messages live in a SQLite database inside a Durable Object in your Cloudflare account. Nothing goes anywhere else. ## Set it up You need a Cloudflare account on the Workers Paid plan (see the note below), Node 20 or later, and your phone. ```sh git clone https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp cd whatsapp-mcp npm install # 1. README 節錄： CVE Intel Know which vulnerabilities matter, and what to do about them. A private desktop app for vulnerability triage, written in native Rust, with a CLI, REST API and MCP server for developers and AI agents. 38 tools, 39 data sources, on-device AI. What it is · Getting started · Features · Install · Local AI · Data sources · Developer notes · Citing Screenshots are taken on a 2560×1440 screen. Click one to see it full size. ## What is CVE Intel? Thousands of software vulnerabilities are published every year, each with an ID such as CVE-2024-3400. For every one of them, security, IT and development teams face the same question: *does this affect us, and do we fix it now or can it wait?* Answering it usually means checking NVD, CISA, FIRST, GitHub and vendor advisories by hand, one browser tab at a time. CVE Intel does that legwork for you. Give it a vulnerability ID, your project's dependency list, or a suspicious IP address, file hash or domain. It checks up to 38 public security sources at once and comes back with one clear, evidence-backed answer: what it is, how risky it is, whether attackers are already using it, and what to do next. README 節錄： ### GPT-6 made computer use the frontier. We make it open. News · Results · Demos · **Quick start** · SDK · Open stack · How it works · Contributing · Contact **Computer use has reached a turning point.** GPT-6 Astra's demos offered an exciting vision of what computer-use agents could make possible, and the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to both visual and programmatic interfaces. The question has changed, from how well a model operates a GUI to how well a system completes work on a real computer by whatever means works. **We call such a system a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA).** It uses a computer in more ways than you do. It reads the accessibility tree and calls app APIs, runs shell commands, and operates the GUI when it needs to. With **code execution**, it writes GUI operations as code and combines them with all of these in one program, with loops and conditions. It can also share the computer with you, working in background windows without interrupting what you are doing. **Yet frontier systems remain largely closed.** We therefore introduce **Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA)**, an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community, including model, system, trajectories, efficiency optimization, and evaluation. **What we open in this version:** - 🧠 **OSWorld integration example** with re

title: humblemuzzu/dumbtv
body:
Take the ads, tracking and clutter out of your Fire TV over ADB, no root. Every step can be undone. Comes with its own open-source home screen.

README 節錄： Your TV should do what you paid for. Ads, tracking and clutter out of your Fire TV. Your apps and HDMI inputs stay. dumbtv.org · Get started · What it blocks · Devices · Get help As seen in TechCrunch · TechRadar · Tom's Guide · Gizmodo · XDA · It's FOSS · and more than 100 others --- ## The story I had a Fire TV Edition television that had become painful to use. Menus lagged, apps took ages to open, and the home screen was mostly ads. When I looked, it had 129 MB of free memory, and much of the rest went to apps that started on their own and to Amazon services that report what you watch. So I asked a coding agent to clean it up over ADB, and posted what happened. People asked for the scripts, so I put them here and shared them. Since then, owners of about twenty other TVs and sticks have run it and sent back what they found. dumbtv is that cleanup, made safe to run on someone else's TV. ## What it does On a Fire TV stick, Cube or Fire TV Edition television, from your computer, with no root: - **Removes the ads and tracking.** Disables Amazon's sponsored rows, ad services, screen fingerprinting (ACR), telemetry and experiments, and turns off ad tracking and usage reporting. - **Blocks what cannot be disabled.** A small open-source DNS filter on the TV stops Amazon's telemetry and automatic updates from reaching their serve

README 節錄：# dsh-sd-bridge-guard **DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 本机 Stable Diffusion 生图九件套 + 违规分流协议（A 档 / C 档）· 跨机器零适配** 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用你电脑里的 Stable Diffusion WebUI 生图：不用提前打开 SD（首次调用自动以纯 API 模式拉起）、不用改任何路径——装上插件就能用。 --- ## 🆕 版本更新内容（v1.0.1 · 2026-10-16） **本轮三件事：下载后能自查缺什么、蒙版可以鼠标手绘、C 档违禁词能注入表单。** ### ① 文件完整性检测（新功能） 别人拿到插件后不再只能靠「跑一下看看报不报错」判断包是否完整——现在有**基线清单 + 反向比对**： ```bash node verify-integrity.mjs # 本机 vs 随包清单，终端彩色表格 node verify-integrity.mjs --remote # 再比对仓库最新版（列出新增/更新/移除） node verify-integrity.mjs --md # Markdown 表格（贴 issue / 回复用） node verify-integrity.mjs --json # 机器可读 ``` 或在 DSH 里直接说「**检查一下 SD 插件少了什么文件**」→ 模型调 `sd_integrity` 工具，回你一张排好版的表： | 状态 | 文件 | 分类 | 大小 | 影响 | |------|------|------|------|------| | ✗ 必需 | `sd-mask-qa.py` | runtime | 6737B | 插件无法运行 | | △ 辅助 | `test-vram-release.ps1` | tool | 3441B | 该功能不可用 | | · 可选 | `CHANGELOG.md` | doc | 123626B | 不影响运行 | 分类决定严重度（`runtime` / `tool` / `doc`·`dev`·`ci`），不搞一刀切——npm 包装不上 dev/doc 是正常的，只有 `runtime` 缺失才是真告警。 **自动触发点**：插件启动时跑一次（缺必需文件记醒目告警）；退出时再跑一次并落盘 `~/.dsh-sd-bridge/integrity-report.{json,md}`。 **发布者侧**：`node gen-manifest.mjs` 生成基线，`--check` 校验是否过期（CI 用）；`prepublishOnly` 已挂自动生成 + 校验。 ### ② 手绘蒙版（新功能） C 档参数表「蒙版」下拉新增 **`手动绘制（鼠标涂抹）`**（紧跟「自动」之后）——选中即弹出参考图，鼠标涂出要重绘的区域： | 操作 | 效果 | |------|------| | 左键拖动 | 涂抹要重绘的区域（笔迹显示为半透明红） | | 右键拖动 | 擦除 | | 滚轮 | 调笔刷大小（6–200 px，标题栏实时显示） | | `C` 键 / 清空 | 清空全部笔迹 | | `Enter` / 确定 | 保存蒙版并出图 | | `Esc` / 取消 | 放弃，**回退自动蒙版**（不静默重画整张） | 画布最长边压到 900 px

body: I posted here about the then-upcoming PHP RCEs related to CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619.
